summary: Cleanup stale test instances and grant access for infra-eco team
description:
Overview:
We have identified a set of long-running/stale test instances (mostly ephemeral GPU VMs and a few reserved volumes) that were created during several internal spike projects in Q4 2025 and have not been claimed. They are incurring small but persistent costs and cluttering the resource inventory.

Impact:
- Monthly spend ~ $1.2k (estimated) for these instances/volumes.
- Inventory noise for infra capacity planning and autoscaler reports.
- Potential security surface (old SSH keys / stale service accounts) if left indefinitely.

Requested actions:
1) Confirm the attached CSV list and terminate instances flagged as STALE-ORPHAN after 72h grace window.
2) Snapshot and retain any volumes that appear to contain non-temporary data (owner label present) and add to archived-volumes S3 bucket.
3) Create an infra-eco service account and grant Miguel Reyes (infra) and Priya Desai (cost-ops) read/write access to the archived bucket and tagging permissions for the affected project.
4) Add a short runbook entry to /confluence/runbooks/instance-cleanup (or link in ticket) describing the verification steps and approval flow.

Steps to locate instances:
- Console path: Cloud Console > Compute > Instances. Filter by label: "spike=true OR temp=true OR created_by=automation-test" and running > 30 days.
- See attached CSV (stale-instances-list-2026-03-01.csv) for pre-filtered candidate list.

Suggested runbook summary (for runbook doc):
- Notify owners via tag-owner email (attempt 48h).
- If no reply, snapshot volumes (if non-empty) to archived-volumes, tag snapshot with INT-7832 and timestamp.
- Terminate instances and record instance IDs in ticket comments.
- Update billing tag on project to "archived" for this set to ensure cost tracking.

Rollback/backout:
- Restore from snapshot if unintended data loss occurs; snapshots retained for 30 days.

Notes and links:
- Related support thread: INT-7720 (previous cleanup run Feb 2026).
- Cost dashboard: https://internal-dashboard.redwood/costs/q4-2025 (internal link).
- Please check ACLs before granting access; follow least-privilege principles.
comments: Aisha Patel: Created ticket after cost review flagged these resources. Attached CSV exported from cloud console.
Miguel Reyes: I'll start owner discovery. Can we get a short approval from infra manager if we terminate after 72h?
Priya Desai: FYI cost-ops approves termination after the grace window. Please snapshot volumes that look non-temp.
Miguel Reyes: Snapshot step completed for volumes vol-0a1b2c3d (see attachment). Terminating instances tomorrow 2026-03-06 unless an owner claims.
Aisha Patel: Thanks — please paste instance IDs and snapshot IDs into the ticket when done.
